title: Women Special Sikkim Darjeeling Group Departure
shortDescription: Trade the everyday for misty mountains, charming hill towns and breathtaking Himalayan experiences with a special ladies-only getaway to Sikkim & Darjeeling.
description: Trade the everyday for misty mountains, charming hill towns and breathtaking Himalayan experiences with a special ladies-only getaway to Sikkim & Darjeeling. Wake up to spectacular mountain views, wander through picturesque landscapes and discover the unique charm of two of India’s most enchanting destinations. From serene monasteries and vibrant local culture to scenic viewpoints and refreshing mountain air, every moment brings a new reason to fall in love with the hills.

Designed especially for women who love discovering new places and making memories along the way, this group departure combines exploration, relaxation and wonderful shared experiences. Leave behind the routine, reconnect with yourself and enjoy the journey with a group of like-minded women. The mountains are waiting, and your next unforgettable chapter could begin here. Bring your adventurous spirit and get ready to experience Sikkim & Darjeeling together.

itinerary.title: Arrival – Gangtok – Welcome to Sikkim
itinerary.description: Arrive in Gangtok and transfer to the hotel. Check in and relax after your journey. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely walk along MG Marg, one of Gangtok’s most vibrant and beautiful shopping areas. Explore local cafés and shops for Sikkimese handicrafts, traditional products, woollens and souvenirs. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir Excursion
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a relaxed sightseeing tour of Gangtok covering Tashi View Point, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Enchey Monastery and Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom. Later, enjoy some leisure time at MG Marg for shopping and photography. Ladies can explore local handicrafts, traditional accessories and Sikkimese products. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Darjeeling – Scenic Himalayan Journey
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Darjeeling. Enjoy the scenic journey through the Himalayan foothills and tea-growing landscapes. On arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. In the evening, visit Darjeeling Mall Road / Chowrasta for shopping and leisure. Enjoy the lively atmosphere and explore local shops offering tea, handicrafts, woollens and souvenirs. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing – Sunrise & Tea Experience
itinerary.description: Start the day early with a visit to Tiger Hill to witness the spectacular sunrise over the Himalayan ranges, subject to weather conditions. Visit Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop while returning to the hotel. After breakfast, continue with local sightseeing covering Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing Rock and a tea garden. Later, enjoy a special tea-tasting experience and some leisure time for shopping at Chowrasta. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed for your onward journey. Depending on the departure schedule, enjoy some free time for last-minute shopping or a relaxed café experience before departure. Tour concludes with beautiful memories of your Ladies Special Sikkim & Darjeeling Holiday.

inclusions: Accommodation for 4 nights in base category room
One child complimentary without bed between 5Y to 12Y
